name: Human project owners create and edit requirements drafts
summary: In simple mode a signed-in project owner creates requirement or narrative content under an existing task and edits it through the requirements API. Editing accepted text creates a separate draft while preserving accepted history and exact references. Current session authority, project ownership and revision/hash checks gate writes. Machine credentials, agents and superusers without owner membership cannot use owner editing controls. Contributor replacement of a validated human owner pending draft is refused in simple mode, including interrupted retries; contributors propose a change instead. Contributor drafts remain revisable, and governed and host operator policies retain their existing authority. The same owner may clear only a failed create with a validated pending revision-1 receipt and no recorded or allocated native row, after complete native absence reads under current project/authority locks. The original receipt and release audit remain; allocated or uncertain rows require original retry or host operator reconciliation. A released identity cannot allocate again.
